remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 4-Level Split in the desirable community of Pollard Meadows! This spacious home features 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a separate entrance to the basement, offering excellent flexibility for large or multi-generational families. Recent upgrades include modern flooring, stylish feature walls, and newer appliances, creating a fresh and contemporary feel throughout. The functional layout provides ample living space, generously sized bedrooms, and plenty of room for entertaining and everyday family living. Ideally located close to schools, parks, public transit, Mill Woods Town Centre, Save-On-Foods, and all essential amenities. Enjoy quick access to Anthony Henday Drive, making commuting anywhere in Edmonton fast and convenient. This move-in-ready home combines space, style, and an unbeatable location (id:67522)
